GET /admin/task-types.name: Transcribe call recordings
GET /admin/task-types.source: Inference job (Whisper-type speech model; Whisper is an MLPerf Inference v6.1 benchmark). One full GPU like 45.5 % of trace tasks; 60 min is above the trace median for inference GPUs (T4: 5.7 min, p90 119 min) because a batch of recordings is bundled. Deadline and volume: ASSUMPTION.

GET /admin/task-types.name: Retrain recommendation (CTR) model
GET /admin/task-types.source: 'ctr' is the 2nd most common workload tag (26 % of tagged instances). 120 min sits between the trace p75 (63 min) and p90 (212 min). Deadline (ready next morning) and volume: ASSUMPTION.

GET /admin/task-types.name: Embed document archive (BERT)
GET /admin/task-types.source: 'bert' is the most common workload tag (53 % of tagged instances). Half a GPU like 15.8 % of trace tasks (26-50 % GPU request). 30 min batches ~ trace p50-p75. Merge waits for all batches. Volume: ASSUMPTION.

GET /admin/task-types.name: Fine-tune language model (NMT/BERT)
GET /admin/task-types.source: Long training tasks carry most GPU time in the trace: tasks of 8 h or more hold 61 % of GPU-hours. 4 workers + an evaluator follows the trace's worker/evaluator roles. Checkpointed, so interruptible. Deadline and volume: ASSUMPTION.

GET /admin/task-types.name: Hyper-parameter sweep
GET /admin/task-types.source: Short tasks on a GPU share: 36.2 % of trace tasks request 25 % of a GPU or less; trace median duration 10 min (rounded up to one 15-min slot). Volume: ASSUMPTION.

fleet.payOffStatement: Electricity costs 2,603 CHF, the heat used is worth 817 CHF. The model does NOT pay off if computing sells for less than 0.23 CHF per server-hour (achieved here: 3.22 CHF), or if electricity costs more than 4.70 CHF/kWh at these computing prices (used: 0.33). Hardware, installation, maintenance and network costs are NOT included: the margin per server-hour (3.00 CHF) must also pay for those.
